# Colony scope: planet-specific values in root variables. pe_ent_val = value of one
# entertainer job here (amenity shortage), pe_spec_<letter> = 1.25 for shares that match the
# planet's designation, else 1.
pe_planet_prepare = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 0.3 }
	}
	if = { limit = { free_amenities < 0 } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 12 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { free_amenities < 1000 } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 4 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_foundry has_designation = col_capital_foundry } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_factory has_designation = col_capital_factory } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_city has_designation = col_capital_trade } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_resort has_designation = col_pleasure } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_mining has_designation = col_capital_extraction } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_generator } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 1.25 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_farming } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 1.25 } } }
}

# Deposit scope: recognise a firm that was placed without variables (e.g. console).

	if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaa } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } }

	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_ffe_3 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 42 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = pe_fcap } } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = 0 } }
}

# Deposit scope: this quarter's values of the firm's variant (entertainment valued for
# this planet), and its class (1 city, 2 mining, 3 generator, 4 farming, 5 lab).
pe_deposit_fetch = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_aaa } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_aaa } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_va value = root.pe_va_d_pe_firm_aac } set_variable = { which = pe_val value = root.pe_val_d_pe_firm_aac } set_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } }

# Colony scope: root.pe_best_variant = most valuable variant available here, above
# root.pe_best_min (0 = none). Planet designation, entertainment need and a random
# factor (0.8-1.2, entrepreneurial spirit) count.
pe_choose_variant = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_best value = pe_best_min }
		set_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 0 }
	}
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aaa CODE = 1 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aac CODE = 2 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aat CODE = 3 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aau CODE = 4 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0.4 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_cca CODE = 5 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = c }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_act CODE = 6 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_acu CODE = 7 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0.4 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_tta CODE = 8 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = t }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_atu CODE = 9 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0.4 PRIM = a }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_uua CODE = 10 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0.7 PRIM = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_ccc CODE = 11 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = c }

pe_found_variant = {
	if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 1 } } } pe_found_firm = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aaa CODE = 1 COST = 200 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 2 } } } pe_found_firm = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aac CODE = 2 COST = 200 SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 16 } }

# Colony scope: buy a state district. Human empires on Free Market get an offer (one per
# quarter); AI empires and Laissez-faire buy directly.
pe_buy_or_offer = {
	if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 1 } } } 
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { is_ai = no has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_offer_pending } check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= 600 } }
			}
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 360 }
			save_event_target_as = pe_offer_planet
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_variant value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_class value = 1 }
				set_timed_country_flag = { flag = pe_offer_pending days = 90 }
				country_event = { id = pe.110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { OR = { is_ai = yes has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } } }
			pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aaa CODE = 1 DISTRICT = district_city SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 8 MINERALS = 500 TRADE = 100 PRICE = 600 }
		}
	 }

			pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_ffm CODE = 41 DISTRICT = district_farming SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 4 MINERALS = 300 TRADE = 60 PRICE = 360 }
		}
	 }
	else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 42 } } } 
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { is_ai = no has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_offer_pending } check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= 360 } }
			}
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 360 }
			save_event_target_as = pe_offer_planet
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_variant value = 42 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_class value = 4 }
				set_timed_country_flag = { flag = pe_offer_pending days = 90 }
				country_event = { id = pe.110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { OR = { is_ai = yes has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } } }
			pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_ffe CODE = 42 DISTRICT = district_farming SITE = d_pe_site_farming MONTHS = 4 MINERALS = 300 TRADE = 60 PRICE = 360 }
		}
	 }
}

# Colony scope, monthly: a finished construction site becomes its firm.
pe_site_complete = {
	root = { set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 0 } }
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_sites check_variable = { which = pe_left value <= 0 } }
		root = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_target }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_tstage }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_kind }
		}
		remove_deposit = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 } } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaa last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aaa days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } else = { owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_found_d_pe_firm_aaa days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaa_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aaa_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aac last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aac days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } else = { owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_found_d_pe_firm_aac days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

# Colony scope: carry out the stage change one firm asked for in its accounts
# (1 expand, 2 shrink, 3 bankrupt). The firm keeps its capital.
pe_firm_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 1 } } }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 0 } }
		random_deposit = {
			limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_pending value > 0 } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_pending }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_code }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_stage }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
			}
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 0 } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaa_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_aaa_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_bankrupt_d_pe_firm_aaa days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 40 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fft_3 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_fft_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fft last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_down_d_pe_firm_fft days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 40 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 3 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_fft_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 40 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_down_d_pe_firm_fft_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 41 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_ffm_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 41 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_ffm_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_bankrupt_d_pe_firm_ffm days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 41 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_ffm_3 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 41 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_ffm_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_ffm last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 41 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_down_d_pe_firm_ffm days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 42 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_ffe_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 42 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_ffe_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_bankrupt_d_pe_firm_ffe days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 42 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_ffe_3 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 42 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_ffe_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_ffe last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 42 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_down_d_pe_firm_ffe days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}

# Colony scope: the state buys back the least valuable firm at the buyout price x stage
# (if it can pay) and rebuilds the district. The firm's capital goes to the investors.
pe_nationalise_one = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = 100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 0 }
	}
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_val value < root.pe_worst } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = prev.pe_val }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 500 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 100 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -500 trade = -100 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 600 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 750 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 150 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -750 trade = -150 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 900 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 1000 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 200 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -1000 trade = -200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 1200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 500 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 100 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -500 trade = -100 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 600 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 750 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 150 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -750 trade = -150 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 900 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 1000 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 200 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -1000 trade = -200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 1200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value > 0 } } }
		set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 180 }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } } } add_district = district_city }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } } } add_district = district_mining }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } } } add_district = district_generator }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } } } add_district = district_farming }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } } } add_district = district_city }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}

# Colony scope: the firm with the largest gain switches to the best variant of its class
# (same footprint and stage) if the gain is at least 3 trade per month. It closes for
# half the build time (a construction site). Paid from the firm's capital, otherwise from
# the investor pool: 100 (city) / 60 (rural) x stage.
pe_restructure = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = 3 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_val_m value = -100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_m value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_val_e value = -100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_e value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_val_f value = -100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_f value = 0 }
	}
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmm CODE = 25 CLS = m }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mma CODE = 26 CLS = m }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmc CODE = 27 CLS = m }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmt CODE = 28 CLS = m }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mme CODE = 29 CLS = m }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmf CODE = 30 CLS = m }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eee CODE = 31 CLS = e }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eea CODE = 32 CLS = e }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eec CODE = 33 CLS = e }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eet CODE = 34 CLS = e }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eem CODE = 35 CLS = e }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eef CODE = 36 CLS = e }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fff CODE = 37 CLS = f }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ffa CODE = 38 CLS = f }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ffc CODE = 39 CLS = f }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fft CODE = 40 CLS = f }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ffm CODE = 41 CLS = f }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ffe CODE = 42 CLS = f }
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_u } set_variable = { which = pe_to value = root.pe_cls_var_u } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_m } set_variable = { which = pe_to value = root.pe_cls_var_m } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_e } set_variable = { which = pe_to value = root.pe_cls_var_e } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 4 } } set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_f } set_variable = { which = pe_to value = root.pe_cls_var_f } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_l } set_variable = { which = pe_to value = root.pe_cls_var_l } }
		subtract_variable = { which = pe_gain value = pe_val }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_gain value > root.pe_best_gain } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = prev.pe_gain }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
				set_variable = { which = pe_to value = prev.pe_to }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 100 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 100 } }
		else = { set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 60 } }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_cost value = pe_stage }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_fcap value >= pe_cost } }
			subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = pe_cost }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= prev.pe_cost } } }
			root = { subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_cost } set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } } }
		set_planet_flag = pe_site
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 3 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 4 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 5 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 6 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 6 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 7 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 7 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 8 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 9 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 9 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 10 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 10 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }

		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 42 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_farming last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 42 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 4 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } } }
		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}
